memory_candidates.content: When a command's prose-described rule must satisfy a literal 'fixture test' acceptance criterion, the rule has to stop being prose. The precedent in this repo is scripts/lib/manifest-routing-lib.sh, which centralized a routing ladder previously restated in several consumers; the same extraction shape (one sourceable lib/*.sh function, one scripts/tests/test-*.sh table-driven suite auto-discovered by run-all.sh) is the standard way to make a /task or /orchestrate prose step assertable. Planning such a task means budgeting a whole phase for the extraction, not treating it as a side effect of the behavioral fix.
